title: MergeBench: A Benchmark for Merging Domain-Specialized LLMs
reasoning: The paper presents MergeBench, a benchmark for evaluating model merging techniques across domains such as instruction following, math, coding, multilinguality, and safety. While the safety domain evaluates a model's ability to refuse harmful prompts (jailbreaking, etc.), it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or explicit moral/ethical systems.
